title: "Awake at 4am posting AI slop": Seth Meyers trolls Donald Trump over clock change comment
source_used: Irish Star (Soap Central page blocked, HTTP 403)
key_facts: On his 5 Oct 2026 show, Seth Meyers mocked President Trump's repeated comments about ending the twice-yearly clock change.
The Irish Star says Trump is pushing the Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act, which would make daylight saving time permanent; the House passed it 308-117 in July.
Senator Tom Cotton has held the bill up, according to the article.
Meyers said nobody changes clocks by hand anymore because phones, computers and cars update automatically.
He joked that the president is awake at 4am posting AI slop on social media.
The article does not show any such post by Trump.
quote_evidence: "What are you talking about? Nobody changes their clocks anymore."
"...it's your internal clock because you're always awake at 4am posting AI slop on social media."
Currently, the 80-year-old is actively pushing the U.S. Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act
why_it_matters_hint: A late-night comedy jab; the AI link is only the joke about posting AI-generated content.
notes: Soap Central page blocked; same story read at Irish Star, which also reports it from the broadcast. The AI angle is a one-line joke.
